design.runner: runHarness(options, runCases): Node 22 guard; exclusive new absolute output dir; git HEAD == expectedSha with no tracked changes; optional normal build (npm.cmd run build, bounded, exit propagated; BUILD_ID must change); hydrated standalone identity (BUILD_ID equal to standalone/.next/BUILD_ID, upgrade/socket/binder/readiness markers in server.js, sha256 of server.js, server.next-config.json and the hydrated src tree); private DB inside the run dir (must not pre-exist); owned child node .next/standalone/server.js (cwd standalone, NODE_ENV=production, HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1, allocated PORT, MULTIPLAYER_STORE=durable, DATABASE_PATH=MULTIPLAYER_DB_PATH=private DB; E2E/PLAYWRIGHT/CAMP/MEKSTATION_/MULTIPLAYER_/NODE_OPTIONS scrubbed); exactly one valid MEKSTATION_LISTENER_READY record for 127.0.0.1/IPv4/requested port plus an HTTP probe answered by the owned listener; bounded readiness/stop/case/command timeouts; finally-kill of owned PIDs only (taskkill /pid <owned> /t /f, windowsHide) and verified port release; early exit, leaked server output, missing/unexpected/duplicate case rows and any retained credential fail the run; failed evidence and DB retained.
design.cases: Real Ed25519 credentials in the production wire format, registered with the redactor before use; bearer HTTP and the mekstation.v1 + mekstation.token.<b64url> subprotocol only. Every inbound frame retained sanitized and scanned (echoed credential or unparseable frame faults the connection; close fails pending waits as premature). Rows: credential-malformed-refused (401), credential-url-refused (400; placeholder, never a real token in a URL), credential-foreign-refused (valid guest credential claiming the host principal: AUTH_REJECTED player-mismatch Close, no replay), participants-authenticated (fog-off 1v1 lobby, seats bound to the authenticated host/guest, LaunchMatch -> active), participant-action-accepted (real AdvancePhase Event correlated by payload.intentId), spectator-seat-witnessed (POST /spectate -> spectator-1; post-join LobbyUpdated shows the watcher only on a spectator seat; server-side session joined line for the watcher principal), spectator-replay-public (ReplayStart/Chunk/End, game_started first, every participant-action event id present, contiguous delivery from 0), spectator-live-public (second actor's real action reaches the spectator live, delivery contiguous with replay), spectator-cannot-act (Error INVALID_INTENT spectator-cannot-act, then a participant action still arrives with no event for the spectator intent and a gapless stream), callbacks-exercised (infrastructure: stop -> offline lineage -> restart -> reconnect on the real image; restart acceptance stays A2's).
design.fixtures: Offline only, via the harness prepareOffline callback after stop (refuses if the private DB is missing or the owning PID is alive); node --import tsx; standalone SQL over mp_matches/mp_match_events with type-only production imports; query_only lineage op. No loader/dependency/src edit, never a production test-mode seam.
design.extensionContract: Frozen A1 interface (A2/B import read-only, add only their own leaves). Runner exports runHarness, createRedactor, parseReadyRecord, imageIdentity, FIXTURES_SCRIPT, LIMITS; options {repoRoot, expectedSha, output, requiredCases, build, buildCommand, standaloneDir, limits}; ctx {port, origin, wsOrigin, identity, pid, limits, evidence.record, redactor, serverOutput(), check(), pass(), stop(), restart(), reconnect(conn, joinOptions), prepareOffline(script, args)}. Cases export A1_REQUIRED_CASES, issueIdentity, api, openSocket (conn.frames/raw, waitFor, send, join, intent, close), runBaseline (returns matchId, identities, conns, replayed), exerciseCallbacks, runA1Cases. Fixtures export openStoppedDb, readMatchMeta, lineage. Runners enumerate requiredCases explicitly; a missing row fails.
design.boundary: No B10 three-declaration matrix, actor/reveal controls or restart/reconnect acceptance (A2); no fog-on refusal rows (B). No /api/e2e, test mode, fake sockets in the production proof, ServerMatchHost import in the assertion process, or noPerViewerRevealProjection override. The node:test falsifiers boot a test-only stub standalone image over real TCP/WebSocket and SQLite; it exercises the harness only and is never product proof.
